paite: Persia kumpipa Kura kum khatna ah, Jeremiah kam a TOUPA thu hihtangtun ahihtheihna ding in, TOUPA'N Persia kumpipa Kura kha atokthou a, huchi in agamsung teng ah thupuan abawl a, agelhthoh in leng akoih hi.
heading: Kura In Judahte Kik Nawn Ding Thu Apia
english: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that Yahweh’s word by Jeremiah’s mouth might be accomplished, Yahweh stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, so that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying,

paite: Hichibang in Persia kumpipa Kura in achi, “TOUPA, van Pathian in, Lei gam tengteng kei ahon peta hi; Judah a om Jerusalem a amah inn lamsak ding in kei thu ahon pia hi.
english: “Cyrus king of Persia says, ‘Yahweh, the God of heaven, has given me all the kingdoms of the earth; and he has commanded me to build him a house in Jerusalem, which is in Judah.

paite: Amite tengteng na lak ua om peuhmah, akiang ah Pathian om henla, Judah a om Jerusalem ah hohtou henla, TOUPA Israel' Pathian, amah Pathian ahi, Jerusalem a om inn lam hen.
english: Whoever there is among you of all his people, may his God be with him, and let him go up to Jerusalem, which is in Judah, and build the house of Yahweh, the God of Israel (he is God), which is in Jerusalem.

paite: Kuapeuh akhualtamna koi mun peuh a nutsiat a omna mun a mite'n, amah dangka leh dangka-eng, vante leh gantate in panpih uhenla, Jerusalem a om Pathian inn a ding a ut thu a thillat chih louh," chi in.
english: Whoever is left, in any place where he lives, let the men of his place help him with silver, with gold, with goods, and with animals, in addition to the free will offering for God’s house which is in Jerusalem.’”

paite: Huchi in Judah leh Benjamin intekpate inkuan a lupente, siampute leh Levite, Pathian in Jerusalem a om TOUPA' inn lam dia hohtou dia akha uh atohthohte tengteng, athouta uhi.
english: Then the heads of fathers’ households of Judah and Benjamin, the priests and the Levites, all whose spirit God had stirred to go up, rose up to build Yahweh’s house which is in Jerusalem.

paite: Huan akimvel ua omte tengteng in akhut uh dangka tui-um belsuan dangka-engte, vante, gantate leh thil manphate in ahihhat ua, uttak a piakte tengteng sim louh in.
english: All those who were around them strengthened their hands with vessels of silver, with gold, with goods, with animals, and with precious things, in addition to all that was willingly offered.

paite: Kumpipa Kura in leng TOUPA' inn a tui-um belsuan Nebukadnezzar in Jerusalem a kipan alakkhiak, pathiante inn a akoihte alakhe vek hi;
english: Also Cyrus the king brought out the vessels of Yahweh’s house, which Nebuchadnezzar had brought out of Jerusalem, and had put in the house of his gods;

paite: Huaite Persia kumpipa Kura in sumkempa Mithredath khut in alakhe vek a, Judah vaihawm, Sesbazzar pia in asimsak hi.
english: even those, Cyrus king of Persia brought out by the hand of Mithredath the treasurer, and counted them out to Sheshbazzar the prince of Judah.

paite: Huchi in hiai amuh zah uh ahi: dangka-eng kuang sawmthum, dangka kuang sangkhat, gimlim halna kuang sawmnih-le-kua;
english: This is the number of them: thirty platters of gold, one thousand platters of silver, twenty-nine knives,

paite: Dangka-eng noubem sawmthum, dangka noubem ahoih lou deuhte zali-le-sawmkhat leh tui-um belsuan dangte sangkhat.
english: thirty bowls of gold, four hundred ten silver bowls of a second kind, and one thousand other vessels.

paite: Dangka-eng leh dangka tui-um belsuan tengteng sangnga-le-zali ahi uh. Saltangte lak ate Babulon a kipan Jerusalem a pitouh a a-om lai un, hiai tengteng Sesbazzar in atawitou vek hi.
english: All the vessels of gold and of silver were five thousand four hundred. Sheshbazzar brought all these up when the captives were brought up from Babylon to Jerusalem.
